about: District rows: [households, ownerHouseholds, medianHouseholdIncome(2024$), medianAge, population, then 22 cells = owner household counts in 11 income bins followed by renter counts in 11 bins]. Income bins (ACS B25118): <5k, 5-10k, 10-15k, 15-20k, 20-25k, 25-35k, 35-50k, 50-75k, 75-100k, 100-150k, 150k+. Key = state-U|L-district code (U upper chamber, L lower chamber). ACS 2020-2024 5-year tabulated for the 2024 districts; Puerto Rico included, Nebraska has upper chamber only, D.C. has its eight wards as the upper-chamber entries. Territories are in the 'territories' block (2020 Island Areas census, 2019 income dollars).
